messages:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing prod entry criteria for the upcoming release. We need final signoff on: SLA targets, support runbooks, docs pages, monitoring alerts, and pricing gating. Can owners call out blockers?
dan: SLA owner here — asking if we can move to P95 ≤ 90ms and P99 ≤ 220ms instead of current P99 ≤ 150ms. 150 is tough without more infra.
ryan: We need a capacity runbook and an autoscale smoke test before we commit. Also need alert thresholds for queue depth and GPU mem. I'll own runbooks.
sarah: I'll own docs + public SLA page. Plan: draft staging KB + public HTML by Wed EOD. Need a short SLA blurb from Dan to publish.
ben: Pricing here — we need a firm per-token estimate for the Dedicated tier and a fallback billing plan for degraded perf (if we fail SLO). I'll draft options; need usage windows from Eng.
ops-bot: checklist created: https://internal/checklists/prod-entry-4443210000 — added owners and due dates.
maria: Thanks — actions: Dan (SLA) due Tue EOD, Ryan (runbooks/tests) due Tue EOD, Sarah (docs + KB) Wed EOD, Ben (pricing fallback) Tue EOD. Quick thumbs if you agree. :thumbsup:
dan: 👍 agree with targets if we add 20% headroom for warm caches.
ryan: 👍 will add test matrix (1k rps, 5k rps) and run on a dedicated night window.
sarah: 👍 will need one review pass from legal for terms wording.
ben: 👍 will sketch pricing fallback and send numbers to infra.
maria: If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll mark prod-entry criteria as green and start handoff to Release. Callouts: add an oncall rota for the first 72h after GA and a listed rollback plan.
ryan: Noted — I'll add oncall rota to runbooks and a rollback play: `rollback --to_tag=stable` short steps.
maria: Great — tagging follow-ups in the checklist and opening a short doc for the release handoff.
